research.notes: ProPublica lists the legal name as 'New Leaders'; the agenda uses 'New Leaders, Inc.'. No Oakland office found; the agenda's Oakland location likely refers to the OUSD side. Searches indicated a 2023-24 OUSD contract for network superintendent and principal coaching, but the one OUSD page I tried to fetch could not be read, so it is not cited.

profile.summary: New Leaders is a nonprofit that trains and supports school leaders. Its programs include a fellowship for aspiring principals, principal coaching, and consulting for school districts. The organization says it works to develop leaders who remove barriers to success for underserved students.

review.notes: New Leaders (New York, NY; EIN 04-3519203; 501(c)(3)) matches the agenda's New Leaders, Inc. in New York and its principal coaching and school improvement services. The cited ProPublica, home and contact pages support the legal name, EIN, org type, address, phone, general email and a neutral summary.
